entities.name: ASC-US with hrHPV
observations: In patients younger than 25 years, ASC-US with positive high-risk HPV is managed with repeat cytology alone in 1 year rather than immediate colposcopy.
Colposcopy is indicated for high-grade cytology at any point or persistent low-grade cytologic abnormality at the 2-year follow-up.

entities.name: Age under 25 cervical screening
observations: A prior normal Pap test at age 21 does not move a 24-year-old into the age 25 or older risk-based algorithm.
The ACS routine screening start age of 25 does not negate management of an abnormal result already obtained before age 25.
